status: Read-only recommendations. No successor implementation or additional numerical qualification is claimed.
scope: Selected 512-hold explicit CPU-context and resident-context VJP paths; full-parent history and decoder; inherited production validation. Relevant methods were inspected statically. Source hashing does not imply every unrelated method was reread.
executive_findings: The explicit algorithm deliberately trades device graphs for CPU boundary tensors. These transfers are storage and VJP dependencies, not merely diagnostic scans; removing them wholesale would undo its memory bound.

Each block rebuilds _block, _sites, and _base four times per update: first forward, second forward, second replay, first replay. At 77472 holds, 512 gives 152 blocks and 608 such calls, versus 606 blocks and 2424 calls at 128. This count excludes global history and decoder work.

The reviewed sweep and explicit executor source has no torch.cuda.synchronize after every kernel. Shape and identity checks do not themselves synchronize. Blocking CPU copies and CUDA scalar Boolean conversions do. GPU Boolean indexing in _base may also force dynamic-size synchronization; actual device trace attribution remains unmeasured.

The lowest-risk next changes are immutable host plans and batched finite checks. Packing asynchronous transfers and fusing first-forward forcing offer larger but unmeasured benefits and need their own full one-step qualification.
No speed percentage or claim of 80 percent GPU utilization can be inferred from this static review.

recommendations.name: Prepare immutable index plans once per authenticated bank binding
recommendations.change: Cache per-block relative sample/member/representative indexes; global 256-site chunk boundaries, holds/inverse/selected rows; history window-relative leaf-group indexes; focal row/hold/column partitions and decoder geometry. Retain exact current global site chunks and original row order. Device packs can be admitted separately; CPU plan reuse alone avoids repeated NumPy search and Torch unique/nonzero/cast/subtract work.
recommendations.guard: Key by original authenticated parent and preparation references, complete bank identity/version stamps, exact partition and device/dtype. Rebind restored banks by content proof once; reject mutation. Keep cheap stamps, dimensions, split and focal identity checks at each update. Charge every new host/device buffer and active lease to the shared governor.
recommendations.limit: A one-block device cache reused only across separated phases may have almost no hit rate. Retaining all parent device topology is a different memory admission and is not recommended without a byte inventory.

recommendations.name: Batch value checks without dropping their predicates
recommendations.change: Keep finite loss and finite context-gradient predicates on device for each decoder tile; combine flags and transfer one Boolean before trunk backward or any optimizer update. Keep missing-gradient structural checks. Combine all 49 finite parameter-gradient flags and the global nonzero predicate into one device result before clip; retain original clip_grad_norm_ with error_if_nonfinite. Combine all 49 updated-parameter finite flags into one result before checkpoint. Convert loss and norm to host once for reuse in progress and return receipts.
recommendations.guard: The rejection point may move later within the same uncommitted update, never past optimizer authorization for a bad pre-step state or checkpoint publication for a bad post-step state. Preserve all tile coverage and zero-focal behavior. A device scalar reduction is still required; batching removes host waits, not the checks.
recommendations.limit: The model has only 32132 parameters, so 49 separate waits may matter more than scan volume. No timing claim is established. Current checks on CPU focal arrays are CPU work, not CUDA waits.

recommendations.name: Separate invariant own-episode proof from learned-value finiteness
recommendations.change: The member weights, episode index, totals, eligible mask, positive minimum denominator and total span are invariant for a bound bank. Compute and validate them once using the existing device arithmetic, retain the scalar denominator and exact eligible mask, and reuse them with stamp validation. The bound on the current upward-state magnitude remains value-dependent and must run each update. Compute a device-side block maximum and explicit nonfinite flag during each first sweep; combine the small results without rescanning every large CPU upward tensor.
recommendations.guard: Do not discard the omitted-foreign finite proof: multiplying a nonfinite foreign value by zero is not numerically equivalent to omitting it. Preserve the magnitude inequality and denominator arithmetic. Explicit nonfinite accumulation is needed: Python max over block scalars does not reliably propagate a NaN appearing after a finite value.
recommendations.limit: The current invariant denominator construction uses FP32 aggregation; moving it to CPU or changing reduction order needs parity proof. Persistent learned maxima across updates are invalid.

recommendations.name: Fuse first-forward forcing while the state is already on device
recommendations.change: For the no-grad custom forward only, compute memory.U(up[representatives] + out[representatives]) before transferring up and out to CPU, and write the same CPU forcing slice. Then retain the existing CPU upward/outside boundaries for the unchanged backward. Eligibility is used only by the second sweep; _forcing does not depend on it, so the global eligibility check need not prevent this local fusion. Finish the learned finite proof before consuming forcing in complete history.
recommendations.guard: Keep exact representative order and the sum-then-U expression. Do not alter backward reverse block order or parameter-VJP accumulation. Do not merge all four block phases across the whole-history barrier. Preserve resource callbacks and account for added transient rank-eight output.
recommendations.limit: This removes the current CPU index_select plus representative H2D round trip in forward. It does not remove the full upward/outside CPU saves or their backward derivatives. This is a new implementation, requiring ragged-boundary and full-parent qualification.

recommendations.name: Pack bounded transfers and overlap with explicit completion events
recommendations.change: Group immutable index arrays by dtype into a contiguous admitted pack with stable offsets; transfer once and expose device views. Use a bounded pinned-host staging buffer and, if measured useful, double-buffer the next block or history window. Retain a CUDA event per in-flight copy and wait only before CPU consumption or buffer reuse; preserve the compute stream order for all scientific reductions.
recommendations.guard: Setting non_blocking=True alone does not establish overlap. Pinned host bytes, the second device buffer, outstanding transfer lifetimes and allocator stream ownership must all be charged and validated. CPU finite scans, CPU history pooling and VJP consumers must never read unfinished D2H buffers. Full-parent CPU boundary arrays need not all be pinned.
recommendations.limit: The history CPU pooling and boundary adjoints remain substantive. Removing their copies requires a separately admitted history-residency redesign. Do not run backward blocks concurrently through shared PyG modules: _edge_messages is a mutable ephemeral channel.

recommendations.name: Precompute immutable mathematical features while keeping learned projections fresh
recommendations.change: Candidates include node age/root/sample indicators, exact degree and nonroot indexes, gate-input observations, observed leaf metadata, categorical input features/called/chosen masks, per-level PyG edge_index, and constant arange indexes. In particular _base currently repeats parent Boolean selection and bincount for all four block passes; a prepared exact degree vector removes that dynamic-size work. Keep categorical MLP, site pooling projection, gates, first/second sweeps and all parameter-connected computations freshly evaluated.
recommendations.guard: Floating log/normalization features should be prepared with the same device FP32 operations or independently qualified; CPU floating preprocessing is not presumed bit-identical. Count/cache feature bytes before retaining them, since some expansions are much larger than compact observations. Cache constant indexes without changing PyG aggregation or edge order.
recommendations.limit: Caching learned base/gates/site embeddings within an update is a different VJP design, because first and second sweep contributions share parameters; treating detached cached learned values as constants would lose gradients. Never cache such learned state across optimizer updates.

recommendations.name: Preallocate the complete context in custom forward
recommendations.change: Allocate one final context tensor inside the custom Function forward and copy each completed block into its disjoint native-hold slice. The custom backward already consumes the supplied complete VJP and replays blocks, so no per-block autograd graph must be preserved by torch.cat.
recommendations.guard: Verify every slice is written once, including the ragged final block, exact shape/dtype/device and no uninitialized entries. Preserve the existing custom backward. No inference about optimizer or scientific equivalence should be made before strict qualification.
recommendations.limit: Resident forward currently holds the block list plus torch.cat output, approximately 2C transient. Preallocation reduces assembly to about C plus one block. Decoder context plus its VJP still needs 2C, so this does not halve the entire update peak. Full TRAIN000 has C=15866265600 bytes.

recommendations.name: Keep diagnostic instrumentation out of the ordinary training path
recommendations.change: Full logits/gradient/parameter/Adam CPU captures, exact cross-arm comparisons and synchronized top-level allocator/timing intervals belong in qualification. Ordinary StageProgress already uses host clocks and a 15-second status thread, with no CUDA query or synchronization. Keep ordinary training on that bounded reporting path; use occasional dedicated measured runs or CUDA events if kernel timing is needed.
recommendations.guard: Do not remove lifecycle/resource admission, current RSS and reserved-memory limits, source identity checks or checkpoint integrity. A timing profile is not a resource guard. memory_allocated/memory_reserved and tensor shape/dtype queries are not per-kernel waits to optimize away. The selected full run should retain all current instrumentation for evidence consistency.
recommendations.limit: The review did not establish an unnecessary CUDA synchronization inside the active outer worker callback. Do not infer one from inherited historical worker files or replace the active guard.

keep_each_update: All native trees, sites, haplotypes and exact 10000 focal identity/coverage; correct TRAIN provenance and target seal.
Exact model/optimizer parameter identities and FP32 dtype; one clip and one AdamW step; first-order custom VJP connectivity; every block and one complete bidirectional history backward.
Current learned-value finite proof, loss/context VJP/parameter-gradient finiteness, nonzero global gradient, finite clip norm and updated parameters.
Shared RSS/device admission, cancellation/deadline and checkpoint integrity.
move_to_authenticated_preparation_or_bin: Coordinate bounds and fixed focal tile partitions.
Whole-parent topology partition, episode eligibility and positive denominator, spans and geometry.
Repeated full bundle value scans after a successful validation of the same stamped bank; preserve identity/version/split/dimension checks at each update.
diagnostic_only: Classifier hooks that copy all logits to CPU.
Capturing every gradient, parameter and Adam moment into CPU comparison dictionaries.
Cross-arm allclose/argmax comparison and per-stage synchronized timing/peak receipts.
not_diagnostics: CPU numerical boundary saves needed to bound live autograd state.
Global eligibility needed by exact own-state shortcut.
Complete history carry and backward propagation across all windows.

qualification_order: First implement immutable host/index preparation and batched finite checks as separate opt-in successors.
Exercise mutations, restored-bank rebinds, ragged 512 blocks, duplicate/boundary focals, noncontiguous VJPs and nonfinite injection; prove bad updates never step or checkpoint.

Compare against original CPU 1 checkpoint 241 at full TRAIN000, FP32 forward/loss atol 1e-6 rtol 1e-5, gradients/parameters/moments atol 1e-6 rtol 1e-4, zero argmax disagreement; preserve RNG and reduction order.
Measure warm timing in balanced order, including all per-update preparation and guards; record incremental host/pinned/device peaks and actual copy/wait attribution.
Only then consider asynchronous transfer or fused forward changes, one at a time; keep complete history and decoder tile size unchanged.
limitations: Read-only source assessment; no profiler trace or model execution performed.
No numerical artifacts, private truth or target payloads were loaded or hashed.
Only fidelity report files were written. Existing runs and production sources were untouched.
